-- Calculate chi-square statistic for association between histological types and CDH1 mutations
-- in female BRCA patients
WITH female_brca AS (
  -- Extract female BRCA patients with known histological types
  SELECT 
    TRIM(SUBSTRING("Patient_description" FROM 'patient (TCGA-[A-Z0-9-]+)')) as barcode,
    "histological_type"
  FROM pancancer_atlas_clinical_info
  WHERE "Patient_description" LIKE '%FEMALE%Breast invasive carcinoma%'
    AND "histological_type" IS NOT NULL
    AND "histological_type" != ''
),
cdh1_mutations AS (
  -- Identify patients with reliable CDH1 mutations (FILTER = 'PASS')
  SELECT DISTINCT "ParticipantBarcode"
  FROM pancancer_atlas_mutation_data
  WHERE "Hugo_Symbol" = 'CDH1'
    AND "FILTER" = 'PASS'
),
patient_mutation_status AS (
  -- Determine CDH1 mutation status for each female BRCA patient
  SELECT 
    fb.barcode,
    fb."histological_type",
    CASE WHEN cm."ParticipantBarcode" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_cdh1_mutation
  FROM female_brca fb
  LEFT JOIN cdh1_mutations cm ON fb.barcode = cm."ParticipantBarcode"
),
contingency_raw AS (
  -- Create raw contingency table
  SELECT 
    "histological_type",
    has_cdh1_mutation,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM patient_mutation_status
  GROUP BY "histological_type", has_cdh1_mutation
),
row_totals AS (
  -- Calculate row margins
  SELECT 
    "histological_type",
    SUM(count) as row_total
  FROM contingency_raw
  GROUP BY "histological_type"
),
filtered_contingency AS (
  -- Filter out categories with marginal totals <= 10
  SELECT 
    cr."histological_type",
    cr.has_cdh1_mutation,
    cr.count,
    rt.row_total
  FROM contingency_raw cr
  JOIN row_totals rt ON cr."histological_type" = rt."histological_type"
  WHERE rt.row_total > 10
),
totals AS (
  -- Calculate column and grand totals
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as grand_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_cdh1_mutation = 0 THEN count ELSE 0 END) as col_0_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_cdh1_mutation = 1 THEN count ELSE 0 END) as col_1_total
  FROM filtered_contingency
),
chi_square_calc AS (
  -- Calculate chi-square contributions for each cell
  SELECT 
    fc."histological_type",
    fc.has_cdh1_mutation,
    fc.count as observed,
    (fc.row_total * 
     CASE WHEN fc.has_cdh1_mutation = 0 THEN t.col_0_total ELSE t.col_1_total END
    ) / t.grand_total::float as expected,
    POWER(fc.count - (fc.row_total * 
     CASE WHEN fc.has_cdh1_mutation = 0 THEN t.col_0_total ELSE t.col_1_total END
    ) / t.grand_total::float, 2) / 
    ((fc.row_total * 
     CASE WHEN fc.has_cdh1_mutation = 0 THEN t.col_0_total ELSE t.col_1_total END
    ) / t.grand_total::float) as chi_sq_contrib
  FROM filtered_contingency fc, totals t
)
SELECT 
  SUM(chi_sq_contrib)::numeric(10, 6) as chi_square_statistic
FROM chi_square_calc
